stories.title: Avdija, Lillard lead Trail Blazers to 116-111 win over Spurs in NBA Cup play
stories.summary: Deni Avdija scored 33 points to lead the Portland Trail Blazers to a 116-111 win over the San Antonio Spurs in both teams’ third NBA Cup matchup of the group.

stories.title: Roman Kantserov scores 2 as the Blackhawks beat the Kraken 3-1, sweep road trip
stories.summary: Roman Kantserov scored two goals, leading the Chicago Blackhawks to a 3-1 victory over the Seattle Kraken.

stories.title: Driver killed in three-vehicle head-on crash on Thanksgiving Eve in Clark County
stories.summary: The Clark County Sheriff's Office says a driver died after a Nissan Versa crossed into oncoming traffic and struck two vehicles Wednesday night.

stories.title: Seattle, King County join efforts to stop ban on transgender athletes in girls' sports
stories.summary: The City of Seattle and King County filed a joint amicus brief on Tuesday in support of the state’s ongoing lawsuit against the initiative.

stories.title: Education funding will be in the spotlight for Oregon's 2027 legislative session amid school closures
stories.summary: The chair of the Senate Education Committee said he and his colleagues are working on around 300 bills dealing with education, including how to fund it.

stories.title: Clark County mom cited, teens arrested in crackdown on illegal electric motorcycles
stories.summary: Dramatic bodycam video shows a teen crashing into a car while fleeing a deputy. As reckless riding surges in Clark County, parents are being held accountable.

stories.title: Dozens of Portland drivers face spike-related tire damage
stories.summary: Portland mechanics report dozens of flat tires caused by unusual spikes, believing the damage to be intentional. Portland Police are investigating.

stories.title: Portland reaches tentative agreement with some city workers as another union continues strike
stories.summary: LiUNA Local 483 Recreation reached a tentative agreement with the city on Monday. A strike by another union, City of Portland Professional Workers, continues.

stories.title: Oregon, Portland and Multnomah County create group to oversee Moda Center renovations
stories.summary: The group was created as part of Senate Bill 1501-B and includes seven members: three appointed by the state, three by the city and one by the county.

stories.title: King tides bring massive waves and some flooding to Lincoln City
stories.summary: High water flooded homes in the Cutler City neighborhood, while officials warn the king tides will continue through Friday.

stories.title: Historic Elk Rock Garden house returns to original estate after $700,000 fundraising effort
stories.summary: The 1918 home, once part of the Peter Kerr estate, is undergoing restoration and could open to visitors within a year.

stories.title: 'The price those families paid is too much': Longview legislator to introduce bill regulating tank safety at pulp and paper mills
stories.summary: State Sen. Jeff Wilson (R) spoke with KGW News about new legislation to regulate above-ground tanks, six months after the Nippon Dynawave disaster.
